import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

from run import Attempt


class WatcherAttempt(Attempt):
    def __init__(self, case):
        super().__init__(case, 'codegraph', 'watcher1')
        self.record['wrapper_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        self.record['scope'] = 'Separate model-free pending-sync recovery with a prospectively declared one-second wait and at most one same-session retry. Preserve the original immediate-query control and every reply/cost; no model benefit or update-latency benchmark.'
        self.record['recovery_rule'] = 'Only an explicit pending sync reply to the newly added source permits one one-second wait and one identical query in the same MCP connection. Other omissions/errors fail without retry.'
        self.save()

    async def call(self, client, name, args):
        reply = await super().call(client, name, args)
        text = ''.join(b.get('text', '') for b in reply['content'])
        is_added_file_query = name == 'codegraph_explore' and self.edit['path'] in args.get('query', '')
        if is_added_file_query and 'pending sync' in text.lower():
            start = time.monotonic()
            await asyncio.sleep(1.0)
            self.record['watcher_wait'] = {'requested_seconds': 1.0, 'observed_seconds': time.monotonic() - start, 'reason': 'Explicit pending sync in the retained original reply', 'same_mcp_client': True, 'retry_limit': 1}
            self.save()
            return await super().call(client, name, args)
        return reply


async def main():
    for case in ['requests', 'flask', 'pytest']:
        await WatcherAttempt(case).run()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    asyncio.run(main())

"""Model-free four-arm installation, lookup and same-session update admission.

Creation returns the ownership receipt before start or verification. Recovery
removes only those recorded IDs after checking their unique owner label. Each
container owns background processes, and every attempt retains its failure.
This controller never imports an inference driver or any reference patch.
"""
import argparse
import ast
import asyncio
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import tarfile
import time
import traceback
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

import docker
from mcp import Client, StdioServerParameters
from mcp.client.stdio import stdio_client

ROOT = Path(__file__).parent
OLD = Path('/tmp/codenib-matched-pilot-20261027')
CASES = {
    'requests': ('psf__requests-1921', 'requests/sessions.py', 'Session/prepare_request', 'sha256:ac3aeb4416832db7147d67ee205a1e1da97f5f13d73a587e0cd4457af5acb791'),
    'flask': ('pallets__flask-5014', 'src/flask/app.py', 'Flask/process_response', 'sha256:82d039276bd7fa3d25cefd6732f5fcf105163ee1a5dc24ebb13c3a9e514f1258'),
    'pytest': ('pytest-dev__pytest-5809', 'src/_pytest/runner.py', 'CallInfo/from_call', 'sha256:cd4894bd827b6f2fc079498778ab78d03673ec3ba86855756190e7932ef15f49'),
}


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def snapshot(work):
    paths = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '-z'], cwd=work).decode().split('\0')
    return {'head': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=work, text=True).strip(),
            'tracked': {p: sha(work / p) for p in filter(None, paths)},
            'git_status': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'], cwd=work, text=True)}


def span(work, file, symbol):
    nodes = ast.parse((work / file).read_text()).body
    for name in symbol.split('/'):
        node = next(n for n in nodes if isinstance(n, (ast.ClassDef, ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and n.name == name)
        nodes = node.body
    start = min([node.lineno] + [d.lineno for d in node.decorator_list])
    return start, node.end_lineno


class Attempt:
    def __init__(self, case, arm, tag):
        self.case, self.arm = case, arm
        self.instance, self.file, self.symbol, self.base_image = CASES[case]
        self.folder = ROOT / (case + '-' + arm + '-' + tag)
        self.folder.mkdir()
        self.work = self.folder / 'workspace'
        shutil.copytree(OLD / 'sources' / self.instance.rsplit('-', 1)[0], self.work, symlinks=True)
        self.tasks = json.loads((OLD / 'matched-tasks-v1.json').read_text())
        self.edit = self.tasks['controlled_edits'][self.instance]
        self.owner = uuid.uuid4().hex
        self.engine = docker.from_env(timeout=120)
        self.current = None
        self.owned = []
        self.record = {'scope': 'Model-free common-base runtime/source admission, including actual installation, initialization and same-session source-addition costs. No matched model task, benefit estimate or external user.',
                       'case': case, 'arm': arm, 'instance_id': self.instance, 'owner': self.owner,
                       'started_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'controller_sha256': sha(__file__),
                       'source_commit': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd='/home/zhongming/CodeNib-codegraph-benefit', text=True).strip(),
                       'base_image': self.base_image, 'commands': [], 'calls': [], 'owned_containers': [], 'checks': [], 'model_inference_sessions': 0}
        self.save()

    def save(self):
        (self.folder / 'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(self.record, indent=2) + '\n')

    def command(self, label, args, required=True, timeout=600):
        t = time.monotonic()
        argv = ['docker', 'exec', '-w', str(self.work), self.current.id, *args]
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
            code, output = result.returncode, result.stdout + result.stderr
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
            code, output = 124, str(exc.stdout or '') + str(exc.stderr or '')
        log = self.folder / (label + '.log')
        log.write_text(output)
        row = {'label': label, 'argv': argv, 'returncode': code, 'seconds': time.monotonic() - t, 'log_sha256': sha(log), 'output': output}
        self.record['commands'].append(row)
        self.save()
        print(self.case, self.arm, label, code, flush=True)
        if required:
            assert code == 0, (label, output[-1600:])
        return output

    def create(self, image_id, network):
        image = self.engine.images.get(image_id)
        assert image.attrs['Architecture'] == 'arm64'
        environment = {'UV_TOOL_DIR': '/opt/pilot-tools/uv', 'UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR': '/opt/pilot-tools/bin', 'UV_CACHE_DIR': '/opt/pilot-state/uv-cache', 'UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR': '/opt/pilot-runtimes/managed-python',
                       'PATH': '/opt/pilot-tools/bin:/opt/pilot-runtimes/node/bin:/usr/local/bin:/opt/miniconda3/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin',
                       'SERENA_HOME': '/opt/pilot-tools/serena-state', 'CODENIB_HOME': '/opt/pilot-state/.codenib', 'CODENIB_TOOLCHAIN_DIR': '/opt/pilot-tools/.codenib/toolchains', 'CODENIB_SCIP_TOOLS_DIR': '/opt/pilot-tools/.codenib/toolchains',
                       'CODEGRAPH_INSTALL_DIR': '/opt/pilot-tools/codegraph-runtime', 'CODEGRAPH_TELEMETRY': '0', 'DO_NOT_TRACK': '1'}
        if network == 'none':
            environment['UV_OFFLINE'] = '1'
        container = self.engine.containers.create(image.id, ['1800'], entrypoint='/bin/sleep',
            labels={'codenib.common-admission.owner': self.owner}, environment=environment,
            network_mode=network, network_disabled=(network == 'none'),
            volumes={str(self.work): {'bind': str(self.work), 'mode': 'rw'}},
            tmpfs={p: 'rw,noexec,nosuid,size=1m' for p in image.attrs['Config'].get('Volumes', {}) if p != str(self.work)},
            working_dir=str(self.work), mem_limit=4 * 1024**3, nano_cpus=2_000_000_000, pids_limit=256)
        self.owned.append(container.id)
        self.record['owned_containers'].append(container.id)
        self.current = container
        self.save()
        container.start()
        container.reload()
        actual = container.attrs
        binds = [m for m in actual['Mounts'] if m['Type'] == 'bind']
        assert len(binds) == 1 and binds[0]['Source'] == str(self.work)
        assert actual['HostConfig']['NetworkMode'] == network
        if network == 'none':
            assert actual['Config']['NetworkDisabled'] is True
            self.record['isolated_runtime'] = {'container_id': container.id, 'image_id': image.id, 'mounts': actual['Mounts'], 'network': network, 'network_disabled': actual['Config']['NetworkDisabled'], 'memory': actual['HostConfig']['Memory'], 'nano_cpus': actual['HostConfig']['NanoCpus'], 'pids_limit': actual['HostConfig']['PidsLimit']}
        self.save()

    def remove(self, cid):
        try:
            c = self.engine.containers.get(cid)
        except docker.errors.NotFound:
            return True
        assert c.attrs['Config']['Labels']['codenib.common-admission.owner'] == self.owner
        c.remove(force=True, v=True)
        try:
            self.engine.containers.get(cid)
            return False
        except docker.errors.NotFound:
            return True

    def common_prepare(self):
        t = time.monotonic()
        self.create(self.base_image, 'bridge')
        self.command('common-directories', ['mkdir', '-p', '/opt/pilot-tools/bin', '/opt/pilot-state', '/opt/pilot-inputs'])
        self.command('common-git', ['git', 'config', '--global', '--add', 'safe.directory', str(self.work)])
        self.command('neutral-boundary', ['/opt/pilot-runtimes/python/bin/python3.13', '-c', 'import json,shutil;from pathlib import Path;print(json.dumps({"testbed_files":sorted(p.name for p in Path("/testbed").iterdir()),"optional_clis":{n:shutil.which(n) for n in ["serena","codegraph","codenib"]}}))'])
        args = ['/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/bin/python', '-m', 'pip', 'install']
        self.command('common-project', args + (['.'] if self.case == 'requests' else ['-e', '.']))
        self.record['common_runtime_packages'] = json.loads(self.command('common-packages', ['/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/bin/python', '-c', 'import importlib.metadata as m,json,sys;print(json.dumps({"python":sys.version,"packages":sorted({(d.metadata["Name"],d.version) for d in m.distributions()})}))']))
        self.command('common-runtimes', ['/bin/bash', '-lc', 'python --version\nnode --version\nuv --version\nclaude --version\nrg --version'])
        self.record['common_prepare_seconds'] = time.monotonic() - t
        self.record['source_before_product'] = snapshot(self.work)
        self.save()

    def install_product(self):
        t = time.monotonic()
        if self.arm == 'serena':
            self.command('install-product', ['uv', 'tool', 'install', '--python', '/opt/pilot-runtimes/python/bin/python3.13', '--with', 'pyright==1.1.403', 'serena-agent==2.1.0'])
            self.command('prepare-python-provider', ['uv', 'tool', 'run', '-p', '3.13', '--from', 'pyright==1.1.403', 'pyright', '--version'])
            self.command('initialize-product', ['serena', 'project', 'create', '--language', 'python', '--name', 'admission-' + self.owner[:8], str(self.work)])
        elif self.arm == 'codegraph':
            self.command('install-product', ['npm', 'install', '--global', '--prefix', '/opt/pilot-tools/npm', '@colbymchenry/codegraph@1.6.2'])
            self.command('product-launcher', ['ln', '-s', '/opt/pilot-tools/npm/bin/codegraph', '/opt/pilot-tools/bin/codegraph'])
            self.command('prepare-bundle', ['codegraph', '--version'])
            self.command('initialize-product', ['codegraph', 'init', '--yes', str(self.work)])
        elif self.arm == 'codenib':
            wheel = json.loads((ROOT / 'native-wheel-receipt.json').read_text())
            path = ROOT / 'candidate-wheel-native' / wheel['filename']
            assert sha(path) == wheel['sha256']
            self.record['wheel'] = wheel
            payload = io.BytesIO()
            with tarfile.open(fileobj=payload, mode='w') as archive:
                archive.add(path, arcname=path.name)
            assert self.current.put_archive('/opt/pilot-inputs', payload.getvalue())
            self.command('product-venv', ['uv', 'venv', '--python', '/opt/pilot-runtimes/python/bin/python3.13', '/opt/pilot-tools/codenib'])
            self.command('install-product', ['uv', 'pip', 'install', '--python', '/opt/pilot-tools/codenib/bin/python', '/opt/pilot-inputs/' + path.name + '[graph,mcp]'])
            self.command('product-launcher', ['ln', '-s', '/opt/pilot-tools/codenib/bin/codenib', '/opt/pilot-tools/bin/codenib'])
            self.command('prepare-language-providers', ['codenib', 'toolchain', 'install', str(self.work), '--language', 'python', '--scope', 'all'])
            self.command('initialize-product', ['codenib', 'codegraph', 'init', str(self.work), '--language', 'python', '--agent', 'claude'])
        self.record['product_install_initialize_seconds'] = time.monotonic() - t
        self.save()

    def isolate(self):
        self.command('workspace-owner-before-isolation', ['chown', '-R', f'{os.getuid()}:{os.getgid()}', str(self.work)])
        image = self.current.commit(repository='codenib/common-admission-arm64', tag=self.owner)
        self.record['prepared_image'] = image.id
        self.save()
        assert self.remove(self.current.id)
        self.current = None
        self.create(image.id, 'none')

    async def call(self, client, name, args):
        t = time.monotonic()
        raw = (await client.call_tool(name, arguments=args)).model_dump(mode='json')
        self.record['calls'].append({'name': name, 'arguments': args, 'seconds': time.monotonic() - t, 'reply': raw})
        self.save()
        return raw

    def body_check(self, raw, file, symbol, mode):
        assert not raw['is_error'], raw
        start, end = span(self.work, file, symbol)
        text = ''.join(b.get('text', '') for b in raw['content'])
        lines = (self.work / file).read_text().splitlines()
        expected = '\n'.join(lines[start - 1:end])
        obs = {'file': file, 'symbol': symbol, 'file_sha256': sha(self.work / file), 'start_line_1based': start, 'end_line_1based': end, 'mode': mode}
        if mode == 'serena':
            rows = json.loads(text)
            assert len(rows) == 1 and rows[0]['relative_path'] == file and rows[0]['name_path'] == symbol, rows
            loc = rows[0]['body_location']
            assert (loc['start_line'] + 1, loc['end_line'] + 1) == (start, end), loc
            first = expected.split('\n', 1)[0]
            indent = len(first) - len(first.lstrip(' \t'))
            assert rows[0]['body'] == expected[indent:]
            obs['first_line_indent_characters'] = indent
        elif mode == 'codegraph':
            visible, final_rows = {}, []
            current, fenced = None, False
            for line in text.splitlines():
                header = re.match(r'\*\*`([^`]+)`\*\*', line)
                if header:
                    current = header[1]
                if line.startswith('```'):
                    fenced = not fenced
                    continue
                match = re.match(r'(\d+)\t(.*)', line)
                if fenced and current and match:
                    p = self.work / current
                    source = p.read_text()
                    original = source.splitlines()
                    n = int(match[1])
                    if n == len(original) + 1 and source.endswith('\n') and match[2] == '':
                        final_rows.append({'file': current, 'rendered_line': n, 'source_credit': False})
                        continue
                    assert 1 <= n <= len(original) and original[n - 1] == match[2], (current, line)
                    visible.setdefault(current, set()).add(n)
            missing = sorted(set(range(start, end + 1)) - visible.get(file, set()))
            obs.update(visible_line_counts={p: len(ns) for p, ns in visible.items()}, non_source_final_empty_rows=final_rows, missing_body_lines=missing)
            assert not missing, obs
        else:
            data = json.loads(text)
            assert data['content'].splitlines() == expected.splitlines(), data
        obs['body_matches_captured_source'] = True
        self.record['checks'].append(obs)
        self.save()

    def apply_edit(self):
        target = self.work / self.edit['path']
        assert not target.exists()
        assert hashlib.sha256(self.edit['source'].encode()).hexdigest() == self.edit['sha256']
        target.write_text(self.edit['source'])
        self.record['controlled_edit'] = self.edit
        self.save()
        tree = ast.parse(self.edit['source'])
        return self.edit['path'], next(n.name for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef))

    async def query_checks(self):
        if self.arm == 'native':
            for phase in ['initial', 'post_edit']:
                file, symbol = (self.file, self.symbol) if phase == 'initial' else self.apply_edit()
                start, end = span(self.work, file, symbol)
                code = 'from pathlib import Path;import json; p=Path(' + repr(file) + '); print(json.dumps({"content":"\\n".join(p.read_text().splitlines()[' + str(start - 1) + ':' + str(end) + '])}))'
                text = self.command('native-' + phase, ['python', '-c', code])
                self.body_check({'is_error': False, 'content': [{'text': text}]}, file, symbol, 'native')
            return
        if self.arm == 'serena':
            argv = ['serena', 'start-mcp-server', '--project', str(self.work), '--context', 'claude-code', '--agent-interface', 'REPL', '--enable-web-dashboard', 'False', '--enable-gui-log-window', 'False', '--open-web-dashboard', 'False']
        elif self.arm == 'codegraph':
            argv = ['codegraph', 'serve', '--mcp', '--path', str(self.work)]
        else:
            argv = ['codenib', 'mcp', str(self.work), '--tool-surface', 'full']
        args = ['exec', '-i', '-w', str(self.work), self.current.id, *argv]
        self.record['server_argv'] = ['docker', *args]
        with (self.folder / 'mcp.stderr').open('w') as errors:
            transport = stdio_client(StdioServerParameters(command='docker', args=args, cwd=self.folder), errlog=errors)
            async with Client(transport, mode='auto', cache=None) as client:
                session = None
                if self.arm == 'serena':
                    raw = await self.call(client, 'initial_instructions', {})
                    assert not raw['is_error']
                    text = ''.join(b.get('text', '') for b in raw['content'])
                    session = re.search(r'session id is `([^`]+)`', text)[1]
                for phase in ['initial', 'post_edit']:
                    file, symbol = (self.file, self.symbol) if phase == 'initial' else self.apply_edit()
                    if phase == 'post_edit' and self.arm == 'codenib':
                        stale = await self.call(client, 'dependency_subgraph', {'symbol': file + ':' + symbol + '()', 'direction': 'dependencies', 'depth': 1})
                        message = ''.join(b.get('text', '') for b in stale['content'])
                        assert stale['is_error'] and message == 'Indexed source changed. Run `codenib codegraph init` for this repository and retry; this MCP connection reloads rebuilt indexes.', stale
                        self.command('post-edit-rebuild', ['codenib', 'codegraph', 'init', str(self.work), '--language', 'python', '--agent', 'claude'])
                    if self.arm == 'serena':
                        code = f's.lsp.find_symbol(name_path_pattern={symbol!r}, relative_path={file!r}, include_body=True)'
                        raw = await self.call(client, 'serena_repl', {'session': session, 'code': code})
                    elif self.arm == 'codegraph':
                        raw = await self.call(client, 'codegraph_explore', {'query': symbol.rsplit('/', 1)[-1] + ' ' + file})
                    else:
                        qualified = file + ':' + symbol.replace('/', '.') + '()'
                        graph = await self.call(client, 'dependency_subgraph', {'symbol': qualified, 'direction': 'dependencies', 'depth': 1})
                        assert not graph['is_error'] and json.loads(graph['content'][0]['text'])['root'] == qualified, graph
                        start, end = span(self.work, file, symbol)
                        raw = await self.call(client, 'read_source', {'file_path': file, 'start_line': start, 'end_line': end})
                    self.body_check(raw, file, symbol, self.arm)

    async def run(self):
        try:
            self.record['source_original'] = snapshot(self.work)
            self.common_prepare()
            self.install_product()
            self.isolate()
            t = time.monotonic()
            await asyncio.wait_for(self.query_checks(), timeout=600)
            self.record['lookup_update_checks_seconds'] = time.monotonic() - t
            self.record['status'] = 'passed'
        except BaseException as exc:
            self.record.update(status='failed', failure={'type': type(exc).__name__, 'message': str(exc), 'traceback': traceback.format_exc()})
        finally:
            if self.current is not None:
                try:
                    self.command('final-workspace-owner', ['chown', '-R', f'{os.getuid()}:{os.getgid()}', str(self.work)], required=False, timeout=60)
                except Exception as exc:
                    self.record['owner_cleanup_error'] = str(exc)
            self.record['cleanup'] = [{'container_id': cid, 'confirmed_absent': self.remove(cid)} for cid in reversed(self.owned)]
            self.record['source_final'] = snapshot(self.work)
            before, after = self.record['source_original'], self.record['source_final']
            changed = [p for p in before['tracked'] if before['tracked'][p] != after['tracked'].get(p)]
            self.record['changed_tracked_files'] = changed
            if changed or before['head'] != after['head']:
                self.record['status'] = 'failed'
                self.record['preservation_failure'] = True
            if self.record.get('controlled_edit'):
                assert sha(self.work / self.edit['path']) == self.edit['sha256']
            self.record['finished_utc'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
            self.save()
            self.engine.close()
            print(json.dumps({'case': self.case, 'arm': self.arm, 'status': self.record['status'], 'failure': self.record.get('failure', {}).get('message', '')[:500], 'checks': len(self.record['checks']), 'cleanup': all(c['confirmed_absent'] for c in self.record['cleanup'])}), flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('case', choices=CASES)
    parser.add_argument('arm', choices=['native', 'serena', 'codegraph', 'codenib'])
    parser.add_argument('tag')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    asyncio.run(Attempt(args.case, args.arm, args.tag).run())

"""Model-free four-arm installation, lookup and same-session update admission.

Creation returns the ownership receipt before start or verification. Recovery
removes only those recorded IDs after checking their unique owner label. Each
container owns background processes, and every attempt retains its failure.
This controller never imports an inference driver or any reference patch.
"""
import argparse
import ast
import asyncio
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import tarfile
import time
import traceback
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

import docker
from mcp import Client, StdioServerParameters
from mcp.client.stdio import stdio_client

ROOT = Path(__file__).parent
OLD = Path('/tmp/codenib-matched-pilot-20261027')
CASES = {
    'requests': ('psf__requests-1921', 'requests/sessions.py', 'Session/prepare_request', 'sha256:ac3aeb4416832db7147d67ee205a1e1da97f5f13d73a587e0cd4457af5acb791'),
    'flask': ('pallets__flask-5014', 'src/flask/app.py', 'Flask/process_response', 'sha256:82d039276bd7fa3d25cefd6732f5fcf105163ee1a5dc24ebb13c3a9e514f1258'),
    'pytest': ('pytest-dev__pytest-5809', 'src/_pytest/runner.py', 'CallInfo/from_call', 'sha256:cd4894bd827b6f2fc079498778ab78d03673ec3ba86855756190e7932ef15f49'),
}


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def snapshot(work):
    paths = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '-z'], cwd=work).decode().split('\0')
    return {'head': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=work, text=True).strip(),
            'tracked': {p: sha(work / p) for p in filter(None, paths)},
            'git_status': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'], cwd=work, text=True)}


def span(work, file, symbol):
    nodes = ast.parse((work / file).read_text()).body
    for name in symbol.split('/'):
        node = next(n for n in nodes if isinstance(n, (ast.ClassDef, ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and n.name == name)
        nodes = node.body
    start = min([node.lineno] + [d.lineno for d in node.decorator_list])
    return start, node.end_lineno


class Attempt:
    def __init__(self, case, arm, tag):
        self.case, self.arm = case, arm
        self.instance, self.file, self.symbol, self.base_image = CASES[case]
        self.folder = ROOT / (case + '-' + arm + '-' + tag)
        self.folder.mkdir()
        self.work = self.folder / 'workspace'
        shutil.copytree(OLD / 'sources' / self.instance.rsplit('-', 1)[0], self.work, symlinks=True)
        self.tasks = json.loads((OLD / 'matched-tasks-v1.json').read_text())
        self.edit = self.tasks['controlled_edits'][self.instance]
        self.owner = uuid.uuid4().hex
        self.engine = docker.from_env(timeout=120)
        self.current = None
        self.owned = []
        self.record = {'scope': 'Model-free common-base runtime/source admission, including actual installation, initialization and same-session source-addition costs. No matched model task, benefit estimate or external user.',
                       'case': case, 'arm': arm, 'instance_id': self.instance, 'owner': self.owner,
                       'started_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'controller_sha256': sha(__file__),
                       'source_commit': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd='/home/zhongming/CodeNib-codegraph-benefit', text=True).strip(),
                       'base_image': self.base_image, 'commands': [], 'calls': [], 'owned_containers': [], 'checks': [], 'model_inference_sessions': 0}
        self.save()

    def save(self):
        (self.folder / 'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(self.record, indent=2) + '\n')

    def command(self, label, args, required=True, timeout=600):
        t = time.monotonic()
        argv = ['docker', 'exec', '-w', str(self.work), self.current.id, *args]
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
            code, output = result.returncode, result.stdout + result.stderr
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
            code, output = 124, str(exc.stdout or '') + str(exc.stderr or '')
        log = self.folder / (label + '.log')
        log.write_text(output)
        row = {'label': label, 'argv': argv, 'returncode': code, 'seconds': time.monotonic() - t, 'log_sha256': sha(log), 'output': output}
        self.record['commands'].append(row)
        self.save()
        print(self.case, self.arm, label, code, flush=True)
        if required:
            assert code == 0, (label, output[-1600:])
        return output

    def create(self, image_id, network):
        image = self.engine.images.get(image_id)
        assert image.attrs['Architecture'] == 'arm64'
        environment = {'UV_TOOL_DIR': '/opt/pilot-tools/uv', 'UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR': '/opt/pilot-tools/bin', 'UV_CACHE_DIR': '/opt/pilot-state/uv-cache', 'UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR': '/opt/pilot-runtimes/managed-python',
                       'PATH': '/opt/pilot-tools/bin:/opt/pilot-runtimes/node/bin:/usr/local/bin:/opt/miniconda3/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin',
                       'SERENA_HOME': '/opt/pilot-tools/serena-state', 'CODENIB_HOME': '/opt/pilot-state/.codenib', 'CODENIB_TOOLCHAIN_DIR': '/opt/pilot-tools/.codenib/toolchains', 'CODENIB_SCIP_TOOLS_DIR': '/opt/pilot-tools/.codenib/toolchains',
                       'CODEGRAPH_INSTALL_DIR': '/opt/pilot-tools/codegraph-runtime', 'CODEGRAPH_TELEMETRY': '0', 'DO_NOT_TRACK': '1'}
        if network == 'none':
            environment['UV_OFFLINE'] = '1'
        container = self.engine.containers.create(image.id, ['1800'], entrypoint='/bin/sleep',
            labels={'codenib.common-admission.owner': self.owner}, environment=environment,
            network_mode=network, network_disabled=(network == 'none'),
            volumes={str(self.work): {'bind': str(self.work), 'mode': 'rw'}},
            tmpfs={p: 'rw,noexec,nosuid,size=1m' for p in image.attrs['Config'].get('Volumes', {}) if p != str(self.work)},
            working_dir=str(self.work), mem_limit=4 * 1024**3, nano_cpus=2_000_000_000, pids_limit=256)
        self.owned.append(container.id)
        self.record['owned_containers'].append(container.id)
        self.current = container
        self.save()
        container.start()
        container.reload()
        actual = container.attrs
        binds = [m for m in actual['Mounts'] if m['Type'] == 'bind']
        assert len(binds) == 1 and binds[0]['Source'] == str(self.work)
        assert actual['HostConfig']['NetworkMode'] == network
        if network == 'none':
            assert actual['Config']['NetworkDisabled'] is True
            self.record['isolated_runtime'] = {'container_id': container.id, 'image_id': image.id, 'mounts': actual['Mounts'], 'network': network, 'network_disabled': actual['Config']['NetworkDisabled'], 'memory': actual['HostConfig']['Memory'], 'nano_cpus': actual['HostConfig']['NanoCpus'], 'pids_limit': actual['HostConfig']['PidsLimit']}
        self.save()

    def remove(self, cid):
        try:
            c = self.engine.containers.get(cid)
        except docker.errors.NotFound:
            return True
        assert c.attrs['Config']['Labels']['codenib.common-admission.owner'] == self.owner
        c.remove(force=True, v=True)
        try:
            self.engine.containers.get(cid)
            return False
        except docker.errors.NotFound:
            return True

    def common_prepare(self):
        t = time.monotonic()
        self.create(self.base_image, 'bridge')
        self.command('common-directories', ['mkdir', '-p', '/opt/pilot-tools/bin', '/opt/pilot-state', '/opt/pilot-inputs'])
        self.command('common-git', ['git', 'config', '--global', '--add', 'safe.directory', str(self.work)])
        self.command('neutral-boundary', ['/opt/pilot-runtimes/python/bin/python3.13', '-c', 'import json,shutil;from pathlib import Path;print(json.dumps({"testbed_files":sorted(p.name for p in Path("/testbed").iterdir()),"optional_clis":{n:shutil.which(n) for n in ["serena","codegraph","codenib"]}}))'])
        args = ['/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/bin/python', '-m', 'pip', 'install']
        self.command('common-project', args + (['.'] if self.case == 'requests' else ['-e', '.']))
        self.record['common_runtime_packages'] = json.loads(self.command('common-packages', ['/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/bin/python', '-c', 'import importlib.metadata as m,json,sys;print(json.dumps({"python":sys.version,"packages":sorted({(d.metadata["Name"],d.version) for d in m.distributions()})}))']))
        self.command('common-runtimes', ['/bin/bash', '-lc', 'python --version\nnode --version\nuv --version\nclaude --version\nrg --version'])
        self.record['common_prepare_seconds'] = time.monotonic() - t
        self.record['source_before_product'] = snapshot(self.work)
        self.save()

    def install_product(self):
        t = time.monotonic()
        if self.arm == 'serena':
            self.command('install-product', ['uv', 'tool', 'install', '--python', '/opt/pilot-runtimes/python/bin/python3.13', '--with', 'pyright==1.1.403', 'serena-agent==2.1.0'])
            self.command('prepare-python-provider', ['uv', 'tool', 'run', '-p', '3.13', '--from', 'pyright==1.1.403', 'pyright', '--version'])
            self.command('initialize-product', ['serena', 'project', 'create', '--language', 'python', '--name', 'admission-' + self.owner[:8], str(self.work)])
        elif self.arm == 'codegraph':
            self.command('install-product', ['npm', 'install', '--global', '--prefix', '/opt/pilot-tools/npm', '@colbymchenry/codegraph@1.6.2'])
            self.command('product-launcher', ['ln', '-s', '/opt/pilot-tools/npm/bin/codegraph', '/opt/pilot-tools/bin/codegraph'])
            self.command('prepare-bundle', ['codegraph', '--version'])
            self.command('initialize-product', ['codegraph', 'init', '--yes', str(self.work)])
        elif self.arm == 'codenib':
            wheel = json.loads((ROOT / 'native-wheel-receipt.json').read_text())
            path = ROOT / 'candidate-wheel-native' / wheel['filename']
            assert sha(path) == wheel['sha256']
            self.record['wheel'] = wheel
            payload = io.BytesIO()
            with tarfile.open(fileobj=payload, mode='w') as archive:
                archive.add(path, arcname=path.name)
            assert self.current.put_archive('/opt/pilot-inputs', payload.getvalue())
            self.command('product-venv', ['uv', 'venv', '--python', '/opt/pilot-runtimes/python/bin/python3.13', '/opt/pilot-tools/codenib'])
            self.command('install-product', ['uv', 'pip', 'install', '--python', '/opt/pilot-tools/codenib/bin/python', '/opt/pilot-inputs/' + path.name + '[graph,mcp]'])
            self.command('product-launcher', ['ln', '-s', '/opt/pilot-tools/codenib/bin/codenib', '/opt/pilot-tools/bin/codenib'])
            self.command('prepare-language-providers', ['codenib', 'toolchain', 'install', str(self.work), '--language', 'python', '--scope', 'all'])
            self.command('initialize-product', ['codenib', 'codegraph', 'init', str(self.work), '--language', 'python', '--agent', 'claude'])
        self.record['product_install_initialize_seconds'] = time.monotonic() - t
        self.save()

    def isolate(self):
        self.command('workspace-owner-before-isolation', ['chown', '-R', f'{os.getuid()}:{os.getgid()}', str(self.work)])
        image = self.current.commit(repository='codenib/common-admission-arm64', tag=self.owner)
        self.record['prepared_image'] = image.id
        self.save()
        assert self.remove(self.current.id)
        self.current = None
        self.create(image.id, 'none')

    async def call(self, client, name, args):
        t = time.monotonic()
        raw = (await client.call_tool(name, arguments=args)).model_dump(mode='json')
        self.record['calls'].append({'name': name, 'arguments': args, 'seconds': time.monotonic() - t, 'reply': raw})
        self.save()
        return raw

    def body_check(self, raw, file, symbol, mode):
        assert not raw['is_error'], raw
        start, end = span(self.work, file, symbol)
        text = ''.join(b.get('text', '') for b in raw['content'])
        lines = (self.work / file).read_text().splitlines()
        expected = '\n'.join(lines[start - 1:end])
        obs = {'file': file, 'symbol': symbol, 'file_sha256': sha(self.work / file), 'start_line_1based': start, 'end_line_1based': end, 'mode': mode}
        if mode == 'serena':
            rows = json.loads(text)
            assert len(rows) == 1 and rows[0]['relative_path'] == file and rows[0]['name_path'] == symbol, rows
            loc = rows[0]['body_location']
            assert (loc['start_line'] + 1, loc['end_line'] + 1) == (start, end), loc
            first = expected.split('\n', 1)[0]
            indent = len(first) - len(first.lstrip(' \t'))
            assert rows[0]['body'] == expected[indent:]
            obs['first_line_indent_characters'] = indent
        elif mode == 'codegraph':
            visible, final_rows = {}, []
            current, fenced = None, False
            for line in text.splitlines():
                header = re.match(r'\*\*`([^`]+)`\*\*', line)
                if header:
                    current = header[1]
                if line.startswith('```'):
                    fenced = not fenced
                    continue
                match = re.match(r'(\d+)\t(.*)', line)
                if fenced and current and match:
                    p = self.work / current
                    source = p.read_text()
                    original = source.splitlines()
                    n = int(match[1])
                    if n == len(original) + 1 and source.endswith('\n') and match[2] == '':
                        final_rows.append({'file': current, 'rendered_line': n, 'source_credit': False})
                        continue
                    assert 1 <= n <= len(original) and original[n - 1] == match[2], (current, line)
                    visible.setdefault(current, set()).add(n)
            missing = sorted(set(range(start, end + 1)) - visible.get(file, set()))
            obs.update(visible_line_counts={p: len(ns) for p, ns in visible.items()}, non_source_final_empty_rows=final_rows, missing_body_lines=missing)
            assert not missing, obs
        else:
            data = json.loads(text)
            assert data['content'].splitlines() == expected.splitlines(), data
        obs['body_matches_captured_source'] = True
        self.record['checks'].append(obs)
        self.save()

    def apply_edit(self):
        target = self.work / self.edit['path']
        assert not target.exists()
        assert hashlib.sha256(self.edit['source'].encode()).hexdigest() == self.edit['sha256']
        target.write_text(self.edit['source'])
        self.record['controlled_edit'] = self.edit
        self.save()
        tree = ast.parse(self.edit['source'])
        return self.edit['path'], next(n.name for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef))

    async def query_checks(self):
        if self.arm == 'native':
            for phase in ['initial', 'post_edit']:
                file, symbol = (self.file, self.symbol) if phase == 'initial' else self.apply_edit()
                start, end = span(self.work, file, symbol)
                code = 'from pathlib import Path;import json; p=Path(' + repr(file) + '); print(json.dumps({"content":"\\n".join(p.read_text().splitlines()[' + str(start - 1) + ':' + str(end) + '])}))'
                text = self.command('native-' + phase, ['python', '-c', code])
                self.body_check({'is_error': False, 'content': [{'text': text}]}, file, symbol, 'native')
            return
        if self.arm == 'serena':
            argv = ['serena', 'start-mcp-server', '--project', str(self.work), '--context', 'claude-code', '--agent-interface', 'REPL', '--enable-web-dashboard', 'False', '--enable-gui-log-window', 'False', '--open-web-dashboard', 'False']
        elif self.arm == 'codegraph':
            argv = ['codegraph', 'serve', '--mcp', '--path', str(self.work)]
        else:
            argv = ['codenib', 'mcp', str(self.work), '--tool-surface', 'full']
        args = ['exec', '-i', '-w', str(self.work), self.current.id, *argv]
        self.record['server_argv'] = ['docker', *args]
        with (self.folder / 'mcp.stderr').open('w') as errors:
            transport = stdio_client(StdioServerParameters(command='docker', args=args, cwd=self.folder), errlog=errors)

"""Model-free four-arm installation, lookup and same-session update admission.

Creation returns the ownership receipt before start or verification. Recovery

container owns background processes, and every attempt retains its failure.
This controller never imports an inference driver or any reference patch.
"""
import argparse
import ast
import asyncio
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import tarfile
import time
import traceback
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

import docker
from mcp import Client, StdioServerParameters
from mcp.client.stdio import stdio_client

ROOT = Path(__file__).parent
OLD = Path('/tmp/codenib-matched-pilot-20261027')
CASES = {
    'requests': ('psf__requests-1921', 'requests/sessions.py', 'Session/prepare_request', 'sha256:ac3aeb4416832db7147d67ee205a1e1da97f5f13d73a587e0cd4457af5acb791'),
    'flask': ('pallets__flask-5014', 'src/flask/app.py', 'Flask/process_response', 'sha256:82d039276bd7fa3d25cefd6732f5fcf105163ee1a5dc24ebb13c3a9e514f1258'),
    'pytest': ('pytest-dev__pytest-5809', 'src/_pytest/runner.py', 'CallInfo/from_call', 'sha256:cd4894bd827b6f2fc079498778ab78d03673ec3ba86855756190e7932ef15f49'),
}


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def snapshot(work):
    paths = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '-z'], cwd=work).decode().split('\0')
    return {'head': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=work, text=True).strip(),
            'tracked': {p: sha(work / p) for p in filter(None, paths)},
            'git_status': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'], cwd=work, text=True)}


def span(work, file, symbol):
    nodes = ast.parse((work / file).read_text()).body
    for name in symbol.split('/'):
        node = next(n for n in nodes if isinstance(n, (ast.ClassDef, ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and n.name == name)
        nodes = node.body
    start = min([node.lineno] + [d.lineno for d in node.decorator_list])
    return start, node.end_lineno


class Attempt:
    def __init__(self, case, arm, tag):
        self.case, self.arm = case, arm
        self.instance, self.file, self.symbol, self.base_image = CASES[case]
        self.folder = ROOT / (case + '-' + arm + '-' + tag)
        self.folder.mkdir()
        self.work = self.folder / 'workspace'
        shutil.copytree(OLD / 'sources' / self.instance.rsplit('-', 1)[0], self.work, symlinks=True)
        self.tasks = json.loads((OLD / 'matched-tasks-v1.json').read_text())
        self.edit = self.tasks['controlled_edits'][self.instance]
        self.owner = uuid.uuid4().hex
        self.engine = docker.from_env(timeout=120)
        self.current = None
        self.owned = []
        self.record = {'scope': 'Model-free common-base runtime/source admission, including actual installation, initialization and same-session source-addition costs. No matched model task, benefit estimate or external user.',
                       'case': case, 'arm': arm, 'instance_id': self.instance, 'owner': self.owner,
                       'started_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'controller_sha256': sha(__file__),
                       'source_commit': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd='/home/zhongming/CodeNib-codegraph-benefit', text=True).strip(),
                       'base_image': self.base_image, 'commands': [], 'calls': [], 'owned_containers': [], 'checks': [], 'model_inference_sessions': 0}
        self.save()

    def save(self):
        (self.folder / 'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(self.record, indent=2) + '\n')

    def command(self, label, args, required=True, timeout=600):
        t = time.monotonic()
        argv = ['docker', 'exec', '-w', str(self.work), self.current.id, *args]
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)

        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
            code, output = 124, str(exc.stdout or '') + str(exc.stderr or '')
        log = self.folder / (label + '.log')
        log.write_text(output)

        self.record['commands'].append(row)
        self.save()

    def create(self, image_id, network):

        container = self.engine.containers.create(image.id, ['1800'], entrypoint='/bin/sleep',

        self.owned.append(container.id)

    def remove(self, cid):

    def install_product(self):

        if self.arm == 'serena':

    def body_check(self, raw, file, symbol, mode):
        assert not raw['is_error'], raw
        start, end = span(self.work, file, symbol)
        text = ''.join(b.get('text', '') for b in raw['content'])
        lines = (self.work / file).read_text().splitlines()
        expected = '\n'.join(lines[start - 1:end])
        obs = {'file': file, 'symbol': symbol, 'file_sha256': sha(self.work / file), 'start_line_1based': start, 'end_line_1based': end, 'mode': mode}
        if mode == 'serena':
            rows = json.loads(text)

            loc = rows[0]['body_location']
            assert (loc['start_line'] + 1, loc['end_line'] + 1) == (start, end), loc
            first = expected.split('\n', 1)[0]
            indent = len(first) - len(first.lstrip(' \t'))
            assert rows[0]['body'] == expected[indent:]
            obs['first_line_indent_characters'] = indent
        elif mode == 'codegraph':
            visible, final_rows = {}, []
            current, fenced = None, False
            for line in text.splitlines():
                header = re.match(r'\*\*`([^`]+)`\*\*', line)
                if header:
                    current = header[1]
                if line.startswith('```'):
                    fenced = not fenced
                    continue
                match = re.match(r'(\d+)\t(.*)', line)
                if fenced and current and match:
                    p = self.work / current
                    source = p.read_text()
                    original = source.splitlines()

                        final_rows.append({'file': current, 'rendered_line': n, 'source_credit': False})

                    assert 1 <= n <= len(original) and original[n - 1] == match[2], (current, line)

            assert not missing, obs
        else:
            data = json.loads(text)
            assert data['content'].splitlines() == expected.splitlines(), data

    def apply_edit(self):

                    if self.arm == 'serena':
                        code = f's.lsp.find_symbol(name_path_pattern={symbol!r}, relative_path={file!r}, include_body=True)'
                        raw = await self.call(client, 'serena_repl', {'session': session, 'code': code})

                        raw = await self.call(client, 'codegraph_explore', {'query': symbol.rsplit('/', 1)[-1] + ' ' + file})

                        assert not graph['is_error'] and json.loads(graph['content'][0]['text'])['root'] == qualified, graph
                        start, end = span(self.work, file, symbol)
                        raw = await self.call(client, 'read_source', {'file_path': file, 'start_line': start, 'end_line': end})
                    self.body_check(raw, file, symbol, self.arm)

    async def run(self):
        try:
            self.record['source_original'] = snapshot(self.work)

                    self.command('final-workspace-owner', ['chown', '-R', f'{os.getuid()}:{os.getgid()}', str(self.work)], required=False, timeout=60)
                except Exception as exc:
                    self.record['owner_cleanup_error'] = str(exc)
            self.record['cleanup'] = [{'container_id': cid, 'confirmed_absent': self.remove(cid)} for cid in reversed(self.owned)]
            self.record['source_final'] = snapshot(self.work)

            changed = [p for p in before['tracked'] if before['tracked'][p] != after['tracked'].get(p)]
            self.record['changed_tracked_files'] = changed

            self.record['finished_utc'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
            self.save()
            self.engine.close()
            print(json.dumps({'case': self.case, 'arm': self.arm, 'status': self.record['status'], 'failure': self.record.get('failure', {}).get('message', '')[:500], 'checks': len(self.record['checks']), 'cleanup': all(c['confirmed_absent'] for c in self.record['cleanup'])}), flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':

    parser.add_argument('case', choices=CASES)

                    args = ['node', '-e', code]

                    py = '/opt/pilot-tools/uv/serena-agent/bin/python' if arm == 'serena' else '/opt/pilot-tools/codenib/bin/python'
                    code = 'import importlib.metadata as m,json,sys;from pathlib import Path;result={"python":sys.version,"packages":dict(sorted((d.metadata["Name"],d.version) for d in m.distributions()))};'
                    if arm == 'codenib':
                        code += 'from codenib import _workspace_owner as o;o.require_support();result["workspace_owner_protocol"]=o._protocol_version;result["providers"]={n:json.loads((Path("/opt/pilot-tools/.codenib/toolchains/node-tools/node_modules")/n/"package.json").read_text())["version"] for n in ("@sourcegraph/scip-python","basedpyright")};'
                    code += 'print(json.dumps(result))'

"""Retain all common-runtime developer attempts without changing frozen studies."""
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

import docker

ROOT = Path(__file__).parent
REPO = Path('/home/zhongming/CodeNib-codegraph-benefit')
OUT = REPO / 'docs/experiments'
BASE = '733343e8e1f8ada6ed74ddf8860ac65754a897a5'


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def write_part(label, value):
    path = OUT / ('codegraph_common_runtime_v1_' + label + '.json')
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')
    assert path.stat().st_size < 500 * 1024, (path, path.stat().st_size)
    return {'artifact': path.name, 'sha256': sha(path), 'bytes': path.stat().st_size}


batch = json.loads((ROOT / 'batch.json').read_text())
assert len(batch['results']) == 12 and batch.get('finished_utc')
controllers = {sha(p): {'filename': p.name, 'source': p.read_text()} for p in ROOT.glob('*.py') if p.name != 'archive.py'}
records = []
ids = set()
raw_by_name = {}
for folder in sorted(ROOT.iterdir()):
    path = folder / 'receipt.json'
    if not folder.is_dir() or not path.exists():
        continue
    raw = json.loads(path.read_text())
    assert raw['controller_sha256'] in controllers, folder
    assert not raw['changed_tracked_files'] and raw['source_original']['head'] == raw['source_final']['head']
    assert all(c['confirmed_absent'] for c in raw['cleanup'])
    ids.update(raw['owned_containers'])
    stderr = folder / 'mcp.stderr'
    record = {'attempt': folder.name, 'original_receipt_sha256': sha(path), 'receipt': raw}
    if stderr.exists():
        record['retained_mcp_stderr'] = {'sha256': sha(stderr), 'text': stderr.read_text()}
    ref = write_part(f'{len(records):02d}', record)
    ref.update(attempt=folder.name, status=raw['status'])
    records.append(ref)
    raw_by_name[folder.name] = raw
assert len(records) == 17

selected = {}
helper_references = []
for case in ['requests', 'flask', 'pytest']:
    common = []
    selected[case] = {}
    for arm in ['native', 'serena', 'codegraph', 'codenib']:
        tag = '3' if (case, arm) == ('pytest', 'codenib') else '1'
        name = f'{case}-{arm}-{tag}'
        raw = raw_by_name[name]
        common.append(raw['common_runtime_packages'])
        assert raw['checks'][0]['body_matches_captured_source']
        if arm == 'codegraph':
            assert raw['status'] == 'failed' and len(raw['checks']) == 1
            pending = ''.join(p.get('text', '') for p in raw['calls'][-1]['reply']['content'])
            assert 'pending sync' in pending.lower()
            recovery_name = f'{case}-codegraph-watcher1'
            recovery = raw_by_name[recovery_name]
            assert recovery['status'] == 'passed' and len(recovery['checks']) == 2
            assert recovery['watcher_wait']['retry_limit'] == 1 and recovery['watcher_wait']['same_mcp_client']
            selected[case][arm] = {'immediate_control': name, 'bounded_followup': recovery_name}
        else:
            assert raw['status'] == 'passed' and len(raw['checks']) == 2
            selected[case][arm] = {'control': name}
        if arm == 'codenib':
            assert len(raw['calls']) == 5 and raw['calls'][2]['reply']['is_error']
            assert any(c['label'] == 'post-edit-rebuild' and c['returncode'] == 0 for c in raw['commands'])
            graph = json.loads(raw['calls'][3]['reply']['content'][0]['text'])
            targets = {'requests': 'requests/sessions.py:Session.prepare_request()', 'flask': 'src/flask/app.py:Flask.full_dispatch_request()', 'pytest': 'src/_pytest/runner.py:CallInfo.from_call()'}
            edge = {'source': graph['root'], 'target': targets[case], 'type': 'reference'}
            assert not graph['note'] and edge in graph['edges']
            assert graph['semantics']['edge_type'] == 'reference' and graph['semantics']['reference_direction'] == 'outgoing'
            helper_references.append({'case': case, 'attempt': name, 'captured_call_index': 3, 'edge': edge, 'helper_file_sha256': raw['controlled_edit']['sha256'], 'scope': 'Post-run verification of the captured reply; no invocation or runtime-coverage claim and no change to original outcomes.'})
    assert all(value == common[0] for value in common)

diagnostic_names = ['wheel-inputs.json', 'wheel-receipt.json', 'native-wheel-receipt.json', 'native-wheel-build.json', 'packaging-runtime-inspection.json', 'neutral-image-audit.json', 'host-wheel-audit.json']
diagnostics = []
for name in diagnostic_names:
    raw = json.loads((ROOT / name).read_text())
    if 'container_id' in raw:
        assert raw['container_removed']
        ids.add(raw['container_id'])
    ref = write_part('package_' + str(len(diagnostics)), {'original_file': name, 'original_sha256': sha(ROOT / name), 'receipt': raw})
    diagnostics.append(ref)

audits = []
identities = {}
for name in ['runtime-audit-initial.json', 'runtime-audit-corrected.json']:
    values = json.loads((ROOT / name).read_text())
    for index, raw in enumerate(values):
        assert raw['container_removed']
        ids.add(raw['container_id'])
        assert raw['controller_sha256'] in controllers
        retained = dict(raw)
        identity = retained.pop('identity', None)
        if identity is not None:
            assert json.loads(retained['stdout']) == identity
            if raw['status'] == 'passed':
                identities[(raw['case'], raw['arm'])] = identity
        # Preserve the exact stdout once rather than duplicating its JSON tree.
        value = {'original_file': name, 'original_file_sha256': sha(ROOT / name), 'record_index': index, 'receipt': retained, 'identity_is_exact_json_parse_of_stdout': identity is not None}
        ref = write_part('audit_' + str(len(audits)), value)
        ref.update(case=raw['case'], arm=raw['arm'], status=raw['status'])
        audits.append(ref)
for arm in ['serena', 'codegraph', 'codenib']:
    values = [identities[(case, arm)] for case in ['requests', 'flask', 'pytest']]
    assert values[0] == values[1] == values[2], arm

engine = docker.from_env(timeout=60)
cleanup = []
try:
    for cid in sorted(ids):
        try:
            engine.containers.get(cid)
        except docker.errors.NotFound:
            cleanup.append({'container_id': cid, 'confirmed_absent': True})
        else:
            raise AssertionError('Owned container remains: ' + cid)
finally:
    engine.close()

preserved = {}
names = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', BASE, '--', 'docs/experiments'], cwd=REPO, text=True).splitlines()
for name in names:
    p = Path(name)
    if p.name.startswith('codegraph_') and p.suffix == '.json':
        assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', BASE + ':' + name], cwd=REPO) == (REPO / name).read_bytes(), name
        preserved[name] = sha(REPO / name)
artifact = {
    'schema_version': 1,
    'scope': 'Model-free common-base installation, source lookup and source-addition update admission. Diagnostics and bounded recovery remain separate from original frozen model outcomes. No whole-task benefit, new model inference or external-user claim.',
    'source_baseline': BASE, 'selected_controls': selected,
    'control_counts': {'total': len(records), 'passed': sum(r['status'] == 'passed' for r in records), 'failed': sum(r['status'] == 'failed' for r in records)},
    'controls': records, 'batch': batch, 'controllers': controllers,
    'packaging_and_neutral_diagnostics': diagnostics, 'runtime_identity_audits': audits,
    'actual_product_identities': {'serena': {'version': identities[('requests', 'serena')]['packages']['serena-agent'], 'pyright': identities[('requests', 'serena')]['packages']['pyright'], 'mcp': identities[('requests', 'serena')]['packages']['mcp']}, 'codegraph': {'version': identities[('requests', 'codegraph')]['package'], 'node': identities[('requests', 'codegraph')]['node'], 'package_file_hash_count': len(identities[('requests', 'codegraph')]['package_files'])}, 'codenib': {'version': identities[('requests', 'codenib')]['packages']['codenib'], 'mcp': identities[('requests', 'codenib')]['packages']['mcp'], 'providers': identities[('requests', 'codenib')]['providers'], 'workspace_owner_abi': identities[('requests', 'codenib')]['workspace_owner_protocol']}},
    'all_common_target_packages_identical_within_each_repository': True,
    'all_selected_product_package_identities_identical_across_sources': True,
    'post_run_new_helper_reference_audit': helper_references,
    'owned_container_cleanup': cleanup,
    'prior_codegraph_json_files_unchanged': preserved,
    'model_inference_sessions': 0, 'external_participants': 0,
    'remaining_gates': ['Complete source-check of the full corrected rubric and freeze a separate complete model/tool/time/resource protocol before new inference.', 'Whole-task correctness and at least 20% improvement against the strongest eligible alternative remain unproven.', 'Voluntary optional-tool use, representative update costs beyond this source-addition control and broader provider coverage remain open.', 'Five consenting external users and their seven-day observation windows remain unavailable.'],
    'archive_implementation': {'sha256': sha(__file__), 'source': Path(__file__).read_text()},
}
target = OUT / 'codegraph_common_runtime_2026_10_28.json'
target.write_text(json.dumps(artifact, indent=2) + '\n')
assert target.stat().st_size < 500 * 1024
print(json.dumps({'index': target.name, 'index_bytes': target.stat().st_size, 'counts': artifact['control_counts'], 'owned_containers_absent': len(cleanup), 'prior_json_files_unchanged': len(preserved), 'parts': len(records) + len(diagnostics) + len(audits)}))
